title: BUGFIX — Fix pipeline errors: fal.ai ETIMEDOUT + FFmpeg subtitle filter
rationale: Two pipeline errors detected in scs001-pipeline-error.log (2026-03-25): (1) Scene s6 generation failed: All fal.ai models failed — spawnSync /bin/sh ETIMEDOUT. signal.alarm(90) doesn't interrupt blocking C extension calls. Fix: use subprocess.Popen with explicit kill. (2) FFmpeg 8.x subtitles filter rejects force_style without 'f=' prefix. Fix: add f= prefix to srt path.

tasks.description: In scripts/scs001/fal-video-client.ts, replace the signal.alarm(90) Python timeout approach with subprocess.Popen + communicate(timeout=85) + proc.kill(). This ensures the fal.ai Python call is reliably killed after 85s even when fal_client.subscribe is blocking in a C extension. Change: rewrite the pyCode to spawn an inner subprocess (subprocess.Popen) for the actual fal_client.subscribe call, catching subprocess.TimeoutExpired and calling proc.kill().

In agents/scs001-caption/index.ts line 148, fix the FFmpeg 8.x subtitles filter: change vfArg from 'subtitles=${srtPath}:force_style=...' to 'subtitles=f=${srtPath}:force_style=...' (add 'f=' prefix for explicit filename option). This fixes 'No option name near' parse error in FFmpeg 8.x.
